title: Newmark Arranges Refinancing for The Clark, a 170-Unit Class A Multifamily Property in Brooklyn
summary: Newmark announces it has arranged a $47.6 million loan on behalf of the Sponsor, The Hudson Companies, to refinance The Clark, a 170-unit multifamily property located at 310 Clarkson Avenue in Brooklyn’s Prospect Lefferts Gardens.
